SYNC register readback/write preservation, mode transition and pointer transaction semantics remain unconfirmed.
primary.safe_observability: Raw register-bit names only until physical mapping established; uniform four-LED state is permutation-invariant but does not complete full model.

independent_candidate.mode_source: Internal S1: FLASH high=Flash, low=Torch; not a guest-readable input
independent_candidate.protocol_source: AW3641E Feb2019 V1.3 pp12-14 Table1/Fig7, exact archived SHA

visual_components.light: Fixed white LED, independent brightness; no glow/beam
visual_components.mode: Retained slide; pointer accessible only covers:false

independent_candidate.original_driver_issue: pulse=brightness*time gives wrong TIME1300 encoding for 7 of 8 levels, unchanged between 2.5.3 and current master
independent_candidate.qemu_entry: Observe real GPIO pad callbacks and QEMU virtual ns; do not infer edges from LEDC duty snapshot.
open_validation: Measure actual Pin bit-bang timing through official UIFlow2 driver; do not widen 0.75..10us just to pass.
Explicitly define unsupported pulse/mid-burst/mode transition envelope where datasheet is silent.
Confirm visible mode detent orientation from own source artwork before automatic position binding.
Exercise guest reset lifecycle; UNIT-HOST-36 listener reset gap is inherited.
independent_candidate.mode_policy_recommendation: Freeze S1 fixture at session creation/before first EN program; do not claim active live-switch semantics. Product/static truth table does not establish dynamic transition timing; power-down guidance is troubleshooting, not an exclusive hardware prohibition.

not_selected.reason: PIN_MODE independently clear, but full Unit also UART_MODE; existing m5_unit_uart_tx only observes bytes for rs485 and does not serialize bit-level optical output.
ESP32-C3 local firmware with I2C/RS485/button/RGB means not the small independent candidate.
Digital AND-of-three A3144E path is clear, but hidden LED has no proven exterior light path and shell deliberately exposes no LED API; unsuitable to force new animation.
